name: getCurrencyType
description:
Retrieves Currency Type master records from EIM/CurrencyType.aspx.
Supports:
Search currency types by currencyCode (exact) OR currencyName (partial) OR currencySymbol (partial)
Show all currency types
Automatically loops through all pages (even if page size is 5/8/9/etc.) so no results are missed
Returns all matching records, not just page 1

basic.name: getCurrencyType
basic.description:
Retrieves Currency Type master records from EIM/CurrencyType.aspx.
Supports:
Search currency types by currencyCode (exact) OR currencyName (partial) OR currencySymbol (partial)
Show all currency types
Automatically loops through all pages (even if page size is 5/8/9/etc.) so no results are missed
Returns all matching records, not just page 1

args.name: currencyCode
args.description: The unique code identifier for the currency (e.g., "000008")

args.name: currencyName
args.description: The full or partial name of the currency to search for (e.g., "Dollar", "Euro")

args.name: currencySymbol
args.description:
The currency symbol to search for (e.g., "AUD," "USD"); 
NOTE: currencySymbol is not currency symbol like "$"; it is a combination of letters "USD."

args.name: mode
args.description: Defines how currency types are retrieved. Case-insensitive. Values like “show all”, “all”, “list of all”, “all existing”, “existing”, or “available” return all records across all pages. “Search” (default) filters results using code, name, or symbol.
